top: My flesh and my heart faileth:
bottom: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

top: But made his own people to go forth like sheep,
bottom: and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

top: I am the LORD thy God...
bottom: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

top: Wilt thou not revive us again:
bottom: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

top: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us:
bottom: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us...

top: I will say of the LORD,
bottom: He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

top: He that dwelleth in the secret place
bottom: of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
